Name: Sophia SVE Voiceover
Author: tianqinghejiuyue
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Used tts2 to provide AI Chinese voiceover for Sophia’s lines in SVE.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Stardew Valley\Mods/......[/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Used tts2 to provide AI Chinese voiceover for Sophia’s lines in SVE. [/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]This mod requires “Stardew Valley Expanded,” which provides the Sophia character. “Sophia SVE Dialogue Expansion” is optional. I also provided tts2 voiceover for that dialogue expansion mod. In theory, it won’t cause bugs even if you don’t install the dialogue expansion mod, because audio playback is implemented by looking up the current dialogue line.[/color]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Thanks to the creators who released the tts2 open-source project.[/color]

Manifest.Description: 索菲亚（SVE）的台词在对话框弹出时自动播放中文配音。音频用 Breeze TTS 2 预先批量生成，本 mod 只负责播放，不占用显卡。
Manifest.Author: 星 & 鲸月
